inputs.vector_definition: deterministic positive Decimal vectors; identical ordered PricePoint inputs are supplied to both implementations

br1_seed_semantics: SMA of the first p closes at observation p, then alpha=2/(p+1) recursive updates with Decimal precision
pandas_default_seed_semantics: first non-null observation is used as the initial ewm state
conclusion: BR1 methodology is retained. The independent pandas recurrence agrees after explicitly injecting the approved SMA seed; pandas default output is not substituted because its initialization semantics differ.
